headline: Claude Fable 5 dominates the day as agent work shifts from prompts to loops, skills, and evals.
executiveSummary: Claude Fable 5 is the highest-momentum signal: @claudeai crossed 91k likes, ClaudeDevs posted migration guidance, and builders immediately shared repo-audit, routing, and workflow patterns.

The practical agent stack is consolidating around loops, installable skills, and harnesses: text-to-lottie, last30days-skill, Google skills, agent-skills, Hivemind, and SkillSpector all point in the same direction.

Coding-agent evaluation is moving toward maintainability and real-world mergeability, with Cognition's FrontierCode and multiple workflow threads pushing success criteria, ADRs, dogfooding, and regression evals.

Business discourse is shifting from generic AI SaaS toward AI-enabled services and SMB operators, with service multiples, small-business economy data, free Ahrefs DR access, and owner-operator workflows creating near-term opportunities.

Papers cluster around long-horizon agents and multimodal memory: SearchSwarm, Role-Agent, Keye-VL-2.0, MemDreamer, and ABot-Earth are practical references for research agents, video agents, and generative worlds.

items.title: @businessbarista

items.title: @GoogleAIStudio

items.title: @paulg
items.body: Paul Graham framed seed valuation as an implied probability bet; it is a simple heuristic for deciding whether a startup's upside justifies the entry price.

items.title: @KingBootoshi
items.body: KingBootoshi argued newer Codex/Claude-class models work better in one stateful goal-driven thread with ADRs and dogfooding than in brittle subagent swarms; useful as a practical agent workflow pattern.

items.title: @JJEnglert
items.body: JJ Englert posted a billion-token Fable 5 field review focused on real work, costs, routing, and quality; the actionable part is using frontier models for planning and review while cheaper models do volume work.

items.title: @hanakoxbt
items.body: Hana Ko highlighted an Anthropic lesson: agents improved when prompts, tools, and context were aggressively reduced; the claimed 62% to 92% eval jump is a warning against overstuffed harnesses.

items.title: @rohanpaul_ai
items.body: Rohan Paul summarized Meta-Agent Challenge, where agents try to build better agents; current systems still struggle with strategy, budgeting, and recovery without human engineering judgment.

items.title: Role-Agent: Bootstrapping LLM Agents via Dual-Role Evolution

items.title: SearchSwarm: Towards Delegation Intelligence in Agentic LLMs for Long-Horizon Deep Research

items.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report

items.title: MemDreamer: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Long Video Understanding via Hierarchical Graph Memory and Agentic Retrieval Mechanism
items.body: Separates perception from reasoning with hierarchical graph memory and agentic retrieval for long-video understanding; useful architecture pattern for video agents that need durable scene memory.
